title: Single Number
statement: Every element appears twice except one. Return the one that appears once. Use linear time and constant extra memory.
constraints: Every element but one appears twice
hints: XOR is its own inverse: x XOR x is 0, and x XOR 0 is x.
XOR is commutative, so pairs cancel regardless of order.
Fold XOR across the array. The leftover bits are the single number.

approaches.name: Hash set
approaches.explanation: Add and remove. The last remaining value is the answer.

editorial: Start from 0 and XOR every value. Each duplicated number returns the accumulator to the state it had before that pair. The unique number is XOR-ed once and remains.
reference_solution:
from typing import Dict, List, Optional, Tuple
from collections import Counter, OrderedDict, defaultdict, deque
import heapq

def single_number(nums: list[int]) -> int:
    acc = 0
    for value in nums:
        acc ^= value
    return acc
